card.name: The "o" starting ophthalmologist after referral
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word ophthalmologist (the "o" after "an"), or "an" itself, in advice to refer patients with eye symptoms to an eye specialist.

modes.label: o after an
modes.description: The letter "o" right after "an" in a referral to an ophthalmologist for visual or eye symptoms.
modes.example: Advise patients to report any visual symptoms and consider referral to an<< o>>phthalmologist for evaluation.

modes.label: an before ophthalmologist
modes.description: The word "an" itself when the next word is expected to be ophthalmologist.
modes.example: Consider referral to<< an>> ophthalmologist in patients who develop oc

card.writes: It pushes the output toward words starting with "o" or "op" and away from eye-related words, so the specialist's name gets spelled out.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name an eye doctor, the ophthalmologist, in a referral sentence.
